title: Durable Integrations
summary: This module provides integrations for making AI agents durable using workflow orchestration systems like DBOS, Prefect, and Temporal. It wraps agents and toolsets to offload operations to durable tasks or steps, ensuring reliability and recoverability.

nodes.label: Orchestrate Agent with DBOS
nodes.title: DBOSAgent
nodes.description: Wraps an existing AI agent to integrate it with DBOS durable workflows. It offloads model requests and tool calls to DBOS steps, ensuring agent runs are reliable and recoverable across failures.

nodes.label: Integrate MCP with DBOS Steps
nodes.title: DBOSMCPToolset
nodes.description: Adapts an MCP (Multi-Capability Platform) toolset for DBOS, converting its tool listing and calling operations into durable DBOS steps. This ensures that interactions with external services via MCP are fault-tolerant.

nodes.label: Orchestrate Agent with Prefect
nodes.title: PrefectAgent
nodes.description: Integrates an AI agent with Prefect, a workflow orchestration system. It transforms agent operations like model requests and tool calls into Prefect tasks, enabling robust, observable, and scheduled agent executions.

nodes.label: Cache Prefect Agent Inputs
nodes.title: PrefectAgentInputs
nodes.description: A custom cache policy for PrefectAgent, designed to generate consistent cache keys for agent inputs. It intelligently filters out non-deterministic fields like timestamps to improve caching efficiency.

nodes.label: Adapt Toolsets for Prefect
nodes.title: prefectify_toolset
nodes.description: A utility function that wraps various toolsets (e.g., FunctionToolset, MCPServer) to make them compatible with Prefect. It converts toolset methods into Prefect tasks for durable execution.

nodes.label: Orchestrate Agent with Temporal
nodes.title: TemporalAgent
nodes.description: Enables an AI agent to run as a Temporal workflow, providing strong durability and reliability guarantees. It converts agent's model interactions and tool executions into Temporal activities for fault-tolerant operation.

nodes.label: Configure Logfire for Temporal
nodes.title: _default_setup_logfire
nodes.description: Provides a default configuration for Logfire, an observability library, specifically tailored for use within Temporal workflows. It instruments Pydantic AI components for enhanced tracing and logging.

nodes.label: Integrate MCP with Temporal Activities
nodes.title: TemporalMCPToolset
nodes.description: Wraps an MCP toolset for Temporal workflows, converting its `get_tools` and `call_tool` methods into Temporal activities. This ensures that interactions with MCP servers are durable and retryable.

nodes.label: Serialize/Deserialize Temporal Run Context
nodes.title: TemporalRunContext
nodes.description: A specialized `RunContext` subclass for Temporal, handling the serialization and deserialization of agent run context data. It ensures that essential context attributes are preserved across Temporal activities.

nodes.label: Adapt Toolsets for Temporal
nodes.title: temporalize_toolset
nodes.description: A function that adapts various toolsets (e.g., FunctionToolset, DynamicToolset, MCP toolsets) for execution within Temporal workflows. It wraps toolset methods as Temporal activities.

nodes.label: Base for Temporal Toolset Adapters
nodes.title: TemporalWrapperToolset
nodes.description: An abstract base class for toolsets that are wrapped for Temporal workflows. It provides common logic for managing the lifecycle and execution of wrapped toolsets within a Temporal environment.

nodes.label: Wrap ACI.dev Tools
nodes.title: ACIToolset
nodes.description: A specialized toolset that integrates and wraps tools defined by the ACI.dev specification. It allows AI agents to seamlessly interact with external services exposed through ACI functions.

nodes.label: Wrap LangChain Tools
nodes.title: LangChainToolset
nodes.description: A toolset designed to wrap and integrate tools from the LangChain ecosystem. It enables Pydantic AI agents to leverage existing LangChain tools within their workflows.

nodes.label: Core Agent Logic
nodes.title: AbstractAgent
nodes.description: Defines the core interface and behavior for all AI agents, providing methods for running and streaming agent interactions. It serves as the base for concrete agent implementations.

nodes.label: Core Toolset Logic
nodes.title: AbstractToolset
nodes.description: Defines the interface for collections of tools that an AI agent can use. It specifies methods for listing available tools and executing them, forming a key part of agent capabilities.

nodes.label: AI Model Interface
nodes.title: Model
nodes.description: Represents an interface for interacting with various AI models, abstracting away provider-specific details. It handles model requests, responses, and streaming capabilities for agents.

nodes.label: DBOS Workflow System
nodes.title: DBOS
nodes.description: An external workflow orchestration system that provides durable execution guarantees. It allows long-running operations to be fault-tolerant and recoverable.

nodes.label: Prefect Workflow System
nodes.title: Prefect
nodes.description: An external dataflow automation and orchestration platform. It enables building, running, and monitoring robust data pipelines and workflows.

nodes.label: Temporal Workflow System
nodes.title: Temporal
nodes.description: An external open-source platform for building and operating resilient applications. It provides durable execution of arbitrary business logic as workflows.

nodes.label: Logfire Observability
nodes.title: Logfire
nodes.description: An external observability and logging library used for instrumenting applications. It helps in tracing and monitoring the execution of code, especially in distributed systems.

nodes.label: Function-based Toolset
nodes.title: FunctionToolset
nodes.description: A standard toolset that manages and executes a collection of Python functions as tools for an AI agent. It provides a straightforward way to expose custom logic to agents.

nodes.label: MCP Server Toolset
nodes.title: MCPServer
nodes.description: A toolset that facilitates communication with an external Multi-Capability Platform (MCP) server. It allows agents to discover and utilize tools hosted on the MCP.

nodes.label: FastMCP Toolset
nodes.title: FastMCPToolset
nodes.description: An optimized toolset for interacting with an MCP server, designed for high-performance scenarios. It provides efficient mechanisms for tool discovery and execution.

nodes.label: Dynamic Toolset
nodes.title: DynamicToolset
nodes.description: A toolset that can dynamically discover and manage tools at runtime. It allows agents to adapt to changing tool availability or requirements without static configuration.

nodes.label: Agent Run Context
nodes.title: RunContext
nodes.description: Provides contextual information for an agent's execution, including dependencies, run ID, metadata, and retry attempts. It's crucial for managing agent state during a run.

groups.label: DBOS Integration
groups.title: DBOS Integration
groups.description: Components for integrating AI agents with the DBOS durable workflow system.

groups.label: Prefect Integration
groups.title: Prefect Integration
groups.description: Components for integrating AI agents with the Prefect workflow orchestration system.

groups.label: Temporal Integration
groups.title: Temporal Integration
groups.description: Components for integrating AI agents with the Temporal durable workflow platform.

groups.label: External Toolset Wrappers
groups.title: External Toolset Wrappers
groups.description: Toolsets designed to wrap and integrate tools from other frameworks like ACI.dev and LangChain.
